about: Owner rename 2026-10-07: S69 „Sokolíkovský dvor“ -> „Pri LEALe“ in the whole game. One batch with every changed text and its context (scratch prompt: rename brief, B17 garage exchange, Zita topic, hints); Claude's final decisions in leal_rename.decisions.csv.
